item.title: NETANYAHU SURVIVES??? Israeli Elections FAIL To Topple Netanyahu Government | America First Ep. 1770
item.description:

He argues Netanyahu will try to restart the war with Iran, reviews the military options and why he thinks the first campaign failed, and covers Gulf states drifting toward Iran. He also lists what he says the US has given Israel, riffs on Trump's rally speeches, and attacks Texas Democrat James Talarico before about 45 minutes of super chats.

item.title: IRAN WAR DAY 237: US Preparing To Resume MAJOR COMBAT OPERATIONS | America First Ep. 1767
item.description:
